description: Reverse DNS (PTR) for up to 20 IPv4 / IPv6 addresses with forward-confirmed reverse DNS (FCrDNS: does the PTR hostname resolve back to the same IP?), PTR name, TTL and NXDOMAIN / SERVFAIL status, over DNS-over-HTTPS.
